sourceInstruction: GO direct delegated message: recent conversations plus authorized full-title search; keep current Recovery/Quick first; add to existing parent, not a new large task.
facts: Conversation creation uses randomUUID; current list query id > after ordered id ASC, not chronological recency.
Catalog requests limit50. ConversationList filters only loaded state.items via lowercase title.includes. App placeholder Find a chat does not communicate that local-page scope.
Legacy contract accepts only after(length<=128) and limit<=50; FlowClient.conversations exposes only these options. Silently replacing existing ID cursor/order would break existing consumers.

ConversationSummary already carries createdAt/updatedAt/projectId. In inspected current writers updated_at changes on turn admission; execution-task progress/queue pause update different state. It must not be labeled last viewed or all background activity.

Catalog sequence counter discards superseded result and dispose aborts center lifetime, but there is no query/project/sort binding or per-new-query request cancellation because no server search exists.
Server list maps rows to conversation summaries; title search need not read turn bodies/details or eagerly fetch every page.
proposedDecisions: Define default recency explicitly, preferably latest accepted user turn with creation fallback from actual persisted metadata, stable id tie-break. Reading/selecting a chat must not secretly update server recency. If a separate local recently-opened list is desired, label it separately.

Keep legacy omitted-mode ID paging unchanged; introduce an explicit supported listing/search mode through the existing conversation/client seam. A new bounded opaque cursor must carry version, filter/sort identity and ordered position; do not reinterpret old ID cursors or silently send new fields to old strict centers.

Search bounded normalized title query over the actual authorized center/project scope at the server. Define literal wildcard escaping/case behavior, query length and result/encoded-response limits; parameterize SQL. Project selection is a filter within real authorization, not an authorization grant.

Use deterministic keyset ordering and a documented concurrent-admission refresh contract. Mutable activity time can move rows between pages; a timestamp ceiling alone is not a historical snapshot. Do not claim gap-free snapshot pagination without the necessary server representation.

Keep current rendered order stable until explicit refresh/new query/load-more boundary; new background work can expose an update notice rather than repeatedly moving focused rows. Preserve selected chat and its draft independently of list visibility.

Catalog binds generation, center identity, project, normalized query, sort and cursor; cancel superseded in-flight requests and discard all stale outcomes. Small debounce may reduce actual requests but must be verified; empty state, retry and legacy loaded-only filtering must be accurately labeled.
Use bounded light summaries and existing data/cache seams. No eager all-page scan, full task body/detail requests, or separate search state ledger.
acceptance: >50 conversations with an exact match only on an unloaded legacy page; new search finds it in bounded result requests.
Same timestamps use deterministic tie-break; next pages/refresh preserve documented behavior under accepted new messages without duplicates or hidden focus/draft mutation.
Rapid q changes and center/project changes reject late old responses; server filtering never crosses authorization. Include malformed/foreign cursor and unsupported old center.
Empty/error/keyboard narrow and themes preserve interaction; background activity does not continuously reshuffle selected/focused rows.
Record actual request count, response bytes and local timings on fixed isolated fixtures. Index presence is not a latency claim; do not benchmark user service or real repo.
